report_name: CISA Warns of Gunra RaaS Targeting Critical Infrastructure

threat_actors.name: Gunra
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation that is actively targeting a broad range of critical infrastructure sectors globally. Gunra is based on the leaked source code of the Conti ransomware and employs a double-extortion model, recruiting affiliates through dark web forums.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used for initial access by exploiting public-facing vulnerabilities, specifically citing CVE-2024-55591 and CVE-2025-24472.

attack_patterns.name: Default Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Used for initial access by using valid accounts with default or easily guessable credentials on remote services like SSL-VPNs.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The core impact of the ransomware, encrypting files on compromised systems and appending the .ENCRT extension.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Used to steal sensitive data from the victim's network before encryption to enable double extortion tactics.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Used vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, preventing system recovery from snapshots.

malware.name: Gunra
malware.description: A 32-bit Windows PE ransomware derived from the leaked Conti v3 source code. It uses a multi-threaded architecture with a ChaCha20 and RSA-4096 encryption scheme, and appends the .ENCRT extension to encrypted files.

malware.name: Conti
malware.description: The infamous ransomware whose leaked v3 source code was used as the basis for the Gunra ransomware.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery before file encryption.

tools.name: qTox
tools.description: A peer-to-peer messaging application used by the Gunra group for ransom negotiation with victims.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2024-55591
vulnerabilities.description: A public-facing vulnerability exploited by the Gunra RaaS operation for initial access.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2025-24472
vulnerabilities.description: A public-facing vulnerability exploited by the Gunra RaaS operation for initial access.

identities.name: Government Sector

identities.description: A critical infrastructure sector targeted by the Gunra RaaS operation.

identities.description: A critical infrastructure sector targeted by the Gunra RaaS operation.

identities.name: Transportation Sector
identities.description: A critical infrastructure sector targeted by the Gunra RaaS operation.

identities.name: Utilities Sector
identities.description: A critical infrastructure sector targeted by the Gunra RaaS operation.

infrastructure.name: Gunra Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dedicated leak site used by the Gunra RaaS operation to publish exfiltrated data from victims who do not pay the ransom.

infrastructure.name: Gunra Negotiation Portal
infrastructure.description: A Tor-based portal used for ransom negotiation between the Gunra operators and their victims.

indicators.name: Gunra Ransomware File Encryption
indicators.pattern:
title: Gunra Ransomware File Encryption Extension
id: 4a9b1c2d-3e4f-5a6b-7c8d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the .ENCRT extension, which is appended by Gunra ransomware.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa26-222a
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.ENCRT'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files being encrypted by Gunra ransomware, identified by the specific .ENCRT file extension.

indicators.name: Gunra Ransom Note Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Gunra Ransom Note Creation
id: 5b8c2d3e-4f5a-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of ransom notes named 'readme.txt', a common behavior for Gunra ransomware.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa26-222a
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\readme.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of ransom notes, commonly named readme.txt, by the Gunra ransomware.

indicators.name: Gunra Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Gunra Ransomware Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 6c7d3e4f-5a6b-7c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a technique used by Gunra ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa26-222a
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command-line execution of vssadmin to delete volume shadow copies, a common precursor to Gunra encryption.

indicators.name: Gunra qTox Negotiation Traffic
indicators.pattern:
title: Gunra qTox Negotiation Traffic
id: 7d8e4f5a-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a-2b3c4d5e6f7g
status: experimental
description: Detects potential negotiation communication with Gunra operators via the qTox P2P messaging service.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa26-222a
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1071
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains: 'qtox.so'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries associated with the qTox P2P messaging service, which is used by Gunra for ransom negotiations.

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: low
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\readme.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the 'readme.txt' file, which is a known ransom note name for Gunra ransomware.
